# SCI-FRUIT v0.1 — Profile Naming And Specialization Rule

Status: **Stage A candidate vocabulary; no profile is selected or approved**

The generic motivating recovery-regime identifiers are:

- `compact_high_snr_response_recovery`; and
- `extended_low_snr_mode_recovery`.

They describe FRUIT-owned recovery transformations. OOF and SZE are motivating
scientific populations only; OOF inference, wavefront interpretation,
telescope correction, SZE astrophysics, cluster modeling, and source claims
remain outside FRUIT authority unless a later owner decision explicitly makes
an observation identity part of the applicability domain.

An ordinary profile-selection policy must use exact pre-output,
owner-authorized observation and signal-domain facts. It cannot run several
methods and select a visually or numerically preferred result. Out-of-domain
requests receive an explicitly authorized route, an experimental override with
downgraded claims, or typed scientific unavailability—never nearest-profile
selection.

Specialization requires prospectively frozen materiality/equivalence bands,
domain prevalence, held-out evidence, and the simplicity/broad-adequacy rule.
The preferred outcome is the simplest method or policy that is broadly
adequate. Multiple methods are retained only when held-out evidence establishes
materially useful specialization rather than benchmark noise.
